translations.web: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.
translations.bsb: You forever overpower him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.
translations.kjv: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
